ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_action_receipt
    ADD COLUMN execution_mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy',
    ADD COLUMN canonical_message_command_id UUID,
    ADD COLUMN canonical_student_message_id UUID;

DO $$
DECLARE
    constraint_name text;
BEGIN
    FOR constraint_name IN
        SELECT conname
        FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'teacher_onboarding_action_receipt'::regclass
          AND contype = 'c'
          AND (
              pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ILIKE '%status%'
              OR pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ILIKE '%claim_token%'
              OR pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ILIKE '%expected_draft_version%'
              OR pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ILIKE '%result_draft_version%'
              OR pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ILIKE '%next_message_id%'
          )
    LOOP
        EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_action_receipt DROP CONSTRAINT %I', constraint_name);
    END LOOP;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_action_receipt
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_execution_mode_ck
        CHECK (execution_mode IN ('legacy', 'canonical')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_status_ck
        CHECK (status IN ('claimed', 'applied', 'completed', 'rejected', 'materialized')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_result_status_ck
        CHECK (result_status IN ('DRAFT', 'COMPLETED')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_claim_pair_ck
        CHECK ((claim_token IS NULL) = (locked_until IS NULL)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_expected_pair_ck
        CHECK ((expected_draft_version IS NULL) = (expected_profile_version IS NULL)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_mode_columns_ck
        CHECK ((execution_mode = 'legacy' AND canonical_message_command_id IS NULL AND canonical_student_message_id IS NULL)
            OR (execution_mode = 'canonical' AND canonical_message_command_id IS NOT NULL)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_shape_ck
        CHECK (
            (execution_mode = 'legacy' AND status IN ('claimed', 'rejected')
                AND result_draft_version IS NULL AND result_profile_version IS NULL AND result_status IS NULL
                AND next_message_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
            OR (execution_mode = 'legacy' AND status = 'applied'
                AND result_draft_version IS NOT NULL AND result_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND result_status IS NOT NULL
                AND next_message_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
            OR (execution_mode = 'legacy' AND status = 'completed'
                AND result_draft_version IS NOT NULL AND result_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND result_status IS NOT NULL
                AND next_message_id IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)
            OR (execution_mode = 'canonical' AND status = 'claimed'
                AND canonical_student_message_id IS NULL AND result_draft_version IS NULL AND result_profile_version IS NULL
                AND result_status IS NULL AND next_message_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
            OR (execution_mode = 'canonical' AND status = 'materialized'
                AND canonical_student_message_id IS NOT NULL AND result_draft_version IS NULL AND result_profile_version IS NULL
                AND result_status IS NULL AND next_message_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
                AND claim_token IS NULL AND locked_until IS NULL)
        ),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_terminal_claim_ck
        CHECK (status IN ('claimed', 'applied') OR (claim_token IS NULL AND locked_until IS NULL));

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_teacher_onboarding_canonical_source_action
    ON teacher_onboarding_action_receipt (dialog_id, source_message_id, source_message_version, block_id, action_id)
    WHERE execution_mode = 'canonical';
